description: For centuries, philosophers and political thinkers have wrestled with one of humanity's greatest questions: What is liberty?The Romans gave us Libertas — the personification of freedom. John Locke wrote of life, liberty, and property. Thomas Jefferson gave us life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. For nearly 250 years, Americans have debated what exactly liberty means.
